ValidationRule.description: Settlement date for opportunity products should only allow week days.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, Opportunity.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Commercial_Opportunity', $User.Profile_Name__c = 'ANZ CCRM Standard User', CASE( MOD( Expected_Settlement_Date__c - DATE(1900, 1, 7), 7 ), 0, 0, 6, 0, 1 ) = 0 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Weekends cannot be selected as Expected Settlement Date.
